race.description: Klein Tools - Evolt - Omega Power Provincial Hcp (Bm68)
race.comment: EMALYN (7) has the most attractive current form, winning first-up at Newcastle before a sound second there when a dominant odds-on favourite. The lost gear late adds some context to that defeat, and she is fitter third-up with a useful claiming rider record. Ticks plenty of boxes. ALL THE WAY MAE (4) resumes with strong Rosehill BM72 form from last campaign and a strong fresh record. Her latest second in a Hawkesbury trial suggests she is forward enough to run a big race. HARRY THE THIEF (1) returns from a five-week break with an excellent winning record. Won well first-up at Goulburn with the 59.5kg and has a solid 1000m profile. Respect in this stronger than country company. CHARLINA (6) handy mare who resumes off an easy Hawkesbury trial win and has a dominant Gosford Class 1 win on the CV. Will relish the claim and is ready to go from the low draw.
